note: Every document this package is held to, by identity rather than by name. conformance/documents.py brings each one down again and refuses anything whose digest does not match.

authority.1: A manufacturer document. What Zilog and its second sources printed about the part.
authority.2: A recording taken off a real part, which is conformance/suites.json rather than a document, so nothing in this folder occupies that rung.
authority.3: Independent research, used only where two lineages that never consulted each other agree, and never as a citation for a figure a manufacturer gave.

whyNotCarriedHere: These are the publishers' and the authors' documents, not this project's, and this repository is public. What is carried is the identity, which is what makes a copy checkable.
alsoInTheFolder: A copy of this folder on a working machine holds background reading as well: Ken Shirriff's die analyses, Harston's undocumented instruction tables, Flammenkamp on interrupt behaviour, Brewer on the special reset, and others. None of them is cited by any claim in this package, so none is listed here. A manifest of documents this package is held to may not include a document nothing here rests on.

documents.title: Z80 CPU User Manual, UM008011-0816
documents.settles: Pin function, machine cycle shape, T states per instruction, what reset does, and which bit of the flag register is which. It is the document the record cites first.

documents.title: Z80 Family Data Book, 00-2490-01
documents.addressNotRecorded: No address for this file is recorded anywhere in this repository, so the fetcher verifies it and never tries to replace it. Finding one is worth doing; inventing one is not.
documents.settles: The one Zilog publication that corrects another. Its Questions and Answers section says outright that a sentence in the CPU Technical Manual is wrong, and its Z8400 and Z84C00 product specification states the two internal T cycles a reset spends after the pin releases, which the user manual never mentions.

documents.title: Z84C00 Product Specification, PS017801-0602
documents.settles: A second witness for the reset cycle, printing the same two internal T cycles as the data book.
documents.thinTextLayer: About twenty nine characters a page, which is a scan with a little text laid over it rather than a text layer. A citation into it is followed by rendering the page and reading it.

documents.title: uPD780C data sheet
documents.settles: That NEC's second source states the three clock cycle reset pulse width and says nothing about internal cycles either way, which is why the two this package charges rest on Zilog's sheet rather than on NEC's.
documents.noTextLayer: No text layer at all. Nothing can search it, so a citation into it is followed by rendering the page and reading it.

documents.title: The Undocumented Z80 Documented, v0.91
documents.settles: How much of an interrupting device's byte reaches the pointer, and what each interrupt response costs, from a lineage that is not the manual's arithmetic.

documents.publisher: Sainz de Baranda y Goni, Brewer, Helcmanovsky
documents.title: Z80 CCF SCF Outcome Stability
documents.settles: That three carry flag rules have been reported and that the third is contested, which is why this package models two of them and no ST part.

documents.title: Undocumented Z80 Flags, rev 1.0
documents.addressNotRecorded: No address for this file is recorded anywhere in this repository.
documents.settles: That NEC's part takes the two undocumented flag bits from the accumulator alone, which is the whole reason the upd780c model exists rather than being another name for the Zilog one.

documents.title: MEMPTR, esoteric register of the ZiLOG Z80 CPU
documents.addressNotRecorded: No address for this file is recorded anywhere in this repository.
documents.settles: The register the community calls MEMPTR and this package calls WZ, worked out by running programs on real machines rather than from any manual.
documents.twoArtifactsOfOneDocument: The References section of README.md pins this document as text, with digest f9e8e87cdd205e15 and no page count. That is a different artifact from the printed copy in this folder, which has the digest above. Both are the same writing and neither is the other, so a reader checking one against the other's digest will find a mismatch that means nothing. The text is what the record was read from; the print is what a reader of this folder holds.
